title: ML-guided synthesis conditions produce EMT zeolite
summary: Researchers trained models on 174 prior synthesis attempts and selected six EMT synthesis conditions for testing. Five yielded EMT by X-ray diffraction; two used starting-mixture Si/Al ratios outside the training range. EMT is an established framework, and the small, researcher-selected study does not establish a general success rate or independent replication.
